## RMI 4226 — Homework 3

Homework 3 focuses on reshaping insurance-company asset data between long and wide formats and creating visualizations with `ggplot2`. The re-edited version includes the completed data preparation, ratio calculations, box plots, faceted comparisons, stacked-bar visualization, and a concise summary of findings.

[Open Homework 3](homework3.html){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

### Topics included

- Data loading and filtering
- `pivot_wider()` and `pivot_longer()`
- Bond and stock ratio calculations
- Point charts and box plots
- Faceted visualizations by company type
- Average bond/stock ratio comparison
